name: Setup Bun
description: Download, install, and setup Bun to your path.

bun-version.description: The version of Bun to install. (e.g. "latest", "canary", "1.0.0", "1.0.x", <sha>)

bun-version-file.description: The version of Bun to install from file. (e.g. "package.json", ".bun-version", ".tool-versions")

bun-download-url.description: Override the URL to download Bun from. This skips version resolution and verifying AVX2 support.

registries.description:
List of package registries with authentication support. Format:
- Default registry: https://registry.npmjs.org/
- Default with token: https://registry.npmjs.org

registry-url.description: The URL of the package registry to use for installing Bun. Set the $BUN_AUTH_TOKEN environment variable to authenticate with the registry.

scope.description: The scope for authenticating with the package registry.

token.description: Personal access token (PAT) used to fetch tags from oven-sh/bun repository. Recommended for resolving wildcard/range versions to avoid GitHub API rate limiting.
